g.text: One misbehaving-client check (duplicated EXTEND2 cell) on a local Chutney network with Tor 0.4.6.10 and 0.4.9.14.
Result: Tor’s own receiver-side check fires only in experimental runs (evidence class E2); outside the abstraction; not a vulnerability.
